hardware.variant: One operator-reported ESP-Mosaico V1.2 sample and a separately prepared R4 LittleFS image.

inputs.name: R4 network-appliance LittleFS image
inputs.revision: Profile recipe validated and image unpacked offline; not boot tested

inputs.name: R3 misplaced-keyword startup attempt
inputs.revision: network-appliance KEYWORD outside the initial rcorder metadata block

scenario: Validate the R4 startup selection with the host-built rcorder and inspect its unpacked LittleFS image; measure available space on the live root before software reboot.
expected: rcorder selects the intended 13 startup scripts in dependency order, the unpacked image retains its provisioned network/SSH inputs and special devices, and removing the standalone ssh-keygen increases available root space.
observed: The host-built rcorder selected, in order: root, sysctl, mountcritlocal, network_tmpdirs, ttys, network, network_logfs, syslogd, wpa_supplicant, dhcpcd, staticroute, mdnsd, sshd. For this selection, each # KEYWORD: network-appliance line must be inside the script's initial contiguous PROVIDE/REQUIRE/BEFORE/KEYWORD metadata block. The unpacked R4 image retained the checked network and SSH inputs and special devices, with 1788 KiB free; the offline image comparison was 704 KiB to 1788 KiB free. Before software reboot, live-root statvfs free space changed from 171 to 424 blocks of 4096 bytes after removing the standalone ssh-keygen (an increase of 1,036,288 bytes). An R3 attempt with the keyword outside the metadata block reached login after reboot but did not start SSH. R4 activation and its /etc/rc duration have not been measured; no R4 Wi-Fi or SSH success is established. The separate ordinary cold POWER baseline remains 283 seconds for /etc/rc with exit status 0.

measurements.name: ordinary-cold-power-rc-baseline
measurements.unit: seconds; rc exit status 0, from separate baseline observation

limits: R4 was validated and unpacked offline but was not activated by reboot in this observation; no R4 boot duration or runtime service status is established.
The login-without-SSH result belongs to the R3 attempt with the KEYWORD outside the initial metadata block, not to R4.
Live-root space values were measured before software reboot; offline image free-space values are a separate comparison.
The 283-second cold POWER baseline is from the separate ordinary R3 boot observation and is not an R4 result.
No working Wi-Fi, SSH, or QML display result is claimed for R4.
